---
title: "Martini 3 - IDP condensates"
description: |
  Martini 3 - IDP impacts the study of biomolecular condensates
sidebar: false
toc: false
author: "Siewert J. Marrink"
date: "08/06/2026"

We have now published a number of works showcasing the use of Martini 3 - IDP to simulate biomolecular condensates in great detail.
See https://doi.org/10.1021/jacs.6c00501 and https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-71778-1 for recent examples.
